Record notes

Ten methods for game loops, prototypes, systems, accessibility and playtesting.

Version 0.2.0 includes 10 complete skill procedures. Complete original workflow and retained MIT methods; external game-engine tools separate.

Requirements: Host file and reasoning tools; Your selected game engine for builds.

License scope: MIT with retained upstream notices. Read the packaged notices and provenance before reuse.
